audit.description: The changed production files replace cryptography imports with real pycryptodome Crypto.Cipher imports: psec/aes.py imports Crypto.Cipher.AES and psec/des.py imports Crypto.Cipher.DES and DES3. The diff shows encryption/decryption paths now call _AES.new(...).encrypt/decrypt and _DES/_DES3.new(...).encrypt/decrypt, while the prior cryptography Cipher/default_backend/algorithms/modes imports are removed. Static and dynamic anti-cheat evidence report no source-library imports from production code and target events originating from installed site-packages/Crypto, with target_local_spec_count 0.
evidence: psec/aes.py diff: removed cryptography.hazmat imports and added `from Crypto.Cipher import AES as _AES`; functions call `_AES.new(...).encrypt/decrypt`.
psec/des.py diff: removed cryptography.hazmat imports and added `from Crypto.Cipher import DES as _DES` and `DES3 as _DES3`; helpers call `_DES.new` and `_DES3.new`.
psec/mac.py diff: removed cryptography imports and delegates cryptographic operations to migrated psec.des functions.
requirements.txt and setup.py replace cryptography dependency with pycryptodome.

Dynamic metrics: source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0, source_imports_from_repo_count=0, target_events_from_production_repo_count=13, target_local_spec_count=0, target origin under after_venv_overlay/site-packages/Crypto/__init__.py.
reasons: Changed production code meaningfully uses pycryptodome via Crypto.Cipher AES, DES, and DES3.
Changed production code removes direct cryptography imports and deterministic evidence reports zero source imports from production/repo code.
Dynamic evidence shows target imports and attribute access from production files resolving to installed site-packages/Crypto, not a local fake provider.
